mechanism: NSAIDs and ARBs (like valsartan) may reduce the antihypertensive efficacy of valsartan when combined with oral contraceptives; additionally, oral contraceptives may increase valsartan plasma concentrations through hepatic metabolism competition.
action: Monitor blood pressure regularly during concurrent use; counsel on contraceptive reliability and ensure adequate blood pressure control; consider alternative antihypertensive if significant BP elevation occurs.
